title: PaddleSpeech r1.5.0
description: Highlight New Features Add AudioTools toolkit support used in DAC (Descript-Audio-Codec) training and inference. Reproduce the losses required for DAC model: MultiScaleSTFTLoss, GANLoss, and SISDRLoss. Version Adaptation Upgrade and adapt PaddleSpeech from Paddle 2.5.1 to Paddle 3.0.0-beta. Address incompatibility issues caused by the new version upgrade of Paddle, perform adaptation development and regression testing on the models in PaddleSpeech, and ensure the suite operates normally without
author: zxcd
